maddeler.e:
استعطفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَفُوا (istaʕṭafū) /is.taʕ.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# اُسْتُعْطِفُوا (ustuʕṭifū) /us.tuʕ.tˤi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# اِسْتَعْطِفُوا (istaʕṭifū) /is.taʕ.tˤi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
